text: FIREReduceLoopIntegrals[glis, topos, path] performs IBP reduction of loop integral listed in glis from the families given in topos using C++ FIRE. It returns reduction tables obtained from FIRE.
Since all processes are started from the current Mathematica notebook, it can be reliably used only for simple integrals and topologies.
